prompts.title: User Interview Script Generator
prompts.description: Create a comprehensive user interview script for [product/feature]. Include warm-up questions, main research objectives, follow-up probes, and closing questions. Focus on understanding user pain points, motivations, and behaviors.

prompts.title: Competitive Analysis Framework
prompts.description: Design a competitive analysis framework comparing [your product] with [competitor 1, 2, 3]. Include feature comparison matrix, user experience evaluation, pricing analysis, and opportunity identification.

prompts.title: User Persona Development
prompts.description: Develop detailed user personas for [target audience]. Include demographics, psychographics, goals, pain points, behaviors, and design implications. Base on research data and user interviews.

prompts.title: Journey Mapping Workshop
prompts.description: Facilitate a user journey mapping session for [user type] using [product/service]. Include touchpoints, emotions, pain points, and opportunities for improvement across all stages.

prompts.title: Survey Design for UX Insights
prompts.description: Create a user survey to gather insights about [research topic]. Include demographic questions, behavior patterns, satisfaction ratings, and open-ended feedback sections.

prompts.title: Card Sorting Analysis
prompts.description: Design and analyze a card sorting exercise for [website/app] navigation. Include methodology, participant recruitment, data analysis framework, and information architecture recommendations.

prompts.title: Usability Testing Protocol
prompts.description: Develop a usability testing protocol for [feature/product]. Include test objectives, task scenarios, success metrics, observation guidelines, and post-test interview questions.

prompts.title: A/B Testing Strategy
prompts.description: Create an A/B testing strategy for [hypothesis]. Include test design, success metrics, statistical significance requirements, and implementation plan with React/Tailwind components.

prompts.title: Analytics Dashboard Design
prompts.description: Design a UX analytics dashboard showing user behavior metrics, conversion funnels, and engagement patterns. Include data visualization best practices and actionable insights.

prompts.title: Stakeholder Interview Guide
prompts.description: Develop a stakeholder interview guide to understand business requirements, technical constraints, and success metrics for [project]. Include questions for different stakeholder types.

prompts.title: WCAG 2.1 AA Compliance Audit
prompts.description: Conduct a comprehensive accessibility audit for [website/app] following WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines. Include color contrast analysis, keyboard navigation testing, and screen reader compatibility.

prompts.title: ARIA Labels Implementation
prompts.description: Implement proper ARIA labels, roles, and properties for [component type]. Include semantic HTML structure, screen reader announcements, and keyboard interaction patterns.

prompts.title: Color Contrast Optimization
prompts.description: Optimize color contrast ratios for [design system] ensuring WCAG AA compliance. Include color palette recommendations, text/background combinations, and accessibility testing tools.

prompts.title: Keyboard Navigation Design
prompts.description: Design keyboard navigation patterns for [interface type]. Include tab order, focus indicators, skip links, and keyboard shortcuts with React/Tailwind implementation examples.

prompts.title: Screen Reader Testing Protocol
prompts.description: Develop a screen reader testing protocol using NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver. Include test scenarios, expected behaviors, and common accessibility issues to identify.

prompts.title: Alternative Text Guidelines
prompts.description: Create comprehensive alt text guidelines for images, icons, and graphics. Include context-specific examples, decorative vs. informative image handling, and automated testing approaches.

prompts.title: Form Accessibility Best Practices
prompts.description: Design accessible forms with proper labels, error handling, and validation messages. Include ARIA attributes, fieldset/legend usage, and assistive technology compatibility.

prompts.title: Motion and Animation Accessibility
prompts.description: Implement accessible motion and animation patterns with reduced motion preferences, focus management, and seizure-safe design principles for [component library].

prompts.title: Mobile Accessibility Testing
prompts.description: Create mobile accessibility testing procedures for iOS and Android. Include touch target sizes, gesture alternatives, and mobile screen reader compatibility testing.

prompts.title: Accessibility Documentation Template
prompts.description: Create accessibility documentation templates for design systems. Include component accessibility notes, implementation guidelines, and testing checklists for developers.

prompts.title: Interactive Prototype with Framer
prompts.description: Create an interactive prototype in Framer for [feature/flow]. Include micro-interactions, state changes, and user flow validation with realistic data and animations.

prompts.title: Figma Auto Layout Components
prompts.description: Design responsive components using Figma Auto Layout for [component type]. Include breakpoint variations, content overflow handling, and developer handoff specifications.

prompts.title: Micro-interaction Design System
prompts.description: Create a micro-interaction design system with hover states, loading animations, and feedback patterns. Include timing functions, easing curves, and implementation guidelines.

prompts.title: User Flow Prototyping
prompts.description: Prototype complete user flows for [user journey] with decision points, error states, and edge cases. Include navigation patterns and state management visualization.

prompts.title: Responsive Design Prototypes
prompts.description: Create responsive prototypes for mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints. Include adaptive layouts, touch interactions, and content prioritization strategies.

prompts.title: Animation and Transition Library
prompts.description: Design a comprehensive animation library with entrance/exit animations, page transitions, and loading states. Include performance considerations and accessibility guidelines.

prompts.title: Component State Management
prompts.description: Prototype component states including loading, error, empty, and success states. Include state transition logic and user feedback mechanisms for [component type].

prompts.title: Gesture-Based Interactions
prompts.description: Design gesture-based interactions for mobile interfaces including swipe, pinch, and long-press patterns. Include haptic feedback and gesture recognition guidelines.

prompts.title: Data Visualization Prototypes
prompts.description: Create interactive data visualization prototypes with filtering, sorting, and drill-down capabilities. Include chart types, interaction patterns, and responsive behavior.

prompts.title: Developer Handoff Specifications
prompts.description: Create comprehensive developer handoff documentation with measurements, spacing, typography, and interaction specifications. Include React/Tailwind code examples and asset exports.

prompts.title: Usability Testing Session Plan
prompts.description: Plan a usability testing session for [feature/product]. Include participant recruitment, test scenarios, observation guidelines, and data collection methods.

prompts.title: A/B Test Design and Analysis
prompts.description: Design and analyze A/B tests for [hypothesis]. Include statistical significance calculations, sample size determination, and results interpretation framework.

prompts.title: Remote User Testing Setup
prompts.description: Set up remote user testing sessions using [platform]. Include participant recruitment, session recording, and data analysis workflows for distributed teams.

prompts.title: Task-Based Testing Scenarios
prompts.description: Create realistic task-based testing scenarios for [user type] using [product]. Include success criteria, completion rates, and error analysis frameworks.

prompts.title: Eye Tracking Study Design
prompts.description: Design an eye tracking study to understand visual attention patterns on [interface]. Include heatmap analysis, fixation sequences, and design optimization recommendations.

prompts.title: Accessibility Testing Protocol
prompts.description: Develop comprehensive accessibility testing using screen readers, keyboard navigation, and assistive technologies. Include WCAG compliance validation and remediation strategies.

prompts.title: Mobile Usability Testing
prompts.description: Conduct mobile usability testing across different devices and operating systems. Include touch interaction analysis, performance testing, and responsive design validation.

prompts.title: Card Sorting Analysis
prompts.description: Analyze card sorting results to optimize information architecture. Include statistical analysis, cluster identification, and navigation structure recommendations.

prompts.title: First Click Testing
prompts.description: Design first click testing to evaluate navigation effectiveness. Include task completion analysis, click path optimization, and interface clarity improvements.

prompts.title: Post-Launch Analytics Review
prompts.description: Analyze post-launch user behavior data to identify optimization opportunities. Include funnel analysis, user engagement metrics, and iterative improvement strategies.

prompts.title: Design Sprint Workshop
prompts.description: Facilitate a design sprint for [problem/challenge]. Include understand, diverge, decide, prototype, and validate phases with cross-functional team collaboration.

prompts.title: Crazy 8s Brainstorming
prompts.description: Lead a Crazy 8s ideation session for [feature/interface]. Generate 8 rapid ideas in 8 minutes, then refine and combine concepts for innovative solutions.

prompts.title: How Might We Questions
prompts.description: Generate 'How Might We' questions for [user problem]. Use HMW framework to reframe challenges into opportunities and spark creative solution generation.

prompts.title: Worst Possible Idea
prompts.description: Use the 'Worst Possible Idea' technique to generate intentionally bad solutions for [challenge]. Then reverse-engineer these to discover innovative approaches.

prompts.title: SCAMPER Innovation Method
prompts.description: Apply SCAMPER (Substitute, Combine, Adapt, Modify, Put to other uses, Eliminate, Reverse) to [existing solution] to generate new ideas and improvements.

prompts.title: Mind Mapping Session
prompts.description: Create a comprehensive mind map for [topic/feature] exploring connections, relationships, and unexpected associations to uncover new design opportunities.

prompts.title: Analogous Inspiration
prompts.description: Find inspiration from unrelated industries and domains to solve [design challenge]. Apply successful patterns from other contexts to create innovative solutions.

prompts.title: Future State Visioning
prompts.description: Envision the ideal future state for [product/experience] in 5-10 years. Include emerging technologies, user needs evolution, and breakthrough innovation opportunities.

prompts.title: Constraint-Based Innovation
prompts.description: Use artificial constraints (time, resources, technology) to force creative problem-solving for [challenge]. Explore how limitations can drive innovation and breakthrough thinking.

prompts.title: Cross-Pollination Workshop
prompts.description: Facilitate cross-pollination between different teams, disciplines, and perspectives to generate fresh ideas for [project]. Include structured sharing and idea combination techniques.
